name: p3_global_base_scaled_index
question: For the reduced K_FldFrame_CreateCtlTask loop shape, does b210 preserve distinct global-base and scaled-index virtual-register roles through selection and scheduling, and when are their physical GPRs chosen?

variants.name: p3_loop_shape
variants.intent: Keeps a gFldUnitsPc global base, a separate local units base, and a 0x1c0-byte scaled loop index; the matching return separately rematerializes gFldUnitsPc plus that scaled index.
